summary: Narrow university campus road with accessible bays; no room to pull clear.
reasons: Narrow lane, bush on east side
Accessible bays and campus buildings beside
No clear shoulder to pull off

best_section.where: Staff House Road beside UQ Global Change Institute

drivers.seclusion: Backs onto bush on the east, but university buildings 9-10 m away on the west and busy campus foot traffic.
drivers.access_and_room: Lane is narrow with bush and footpath either side; no clear level ground to pull fully off the lane.
drivers.traffic: Campus service road with daytime vehicle and pedestrian use; one car parked nearby.
drivers.convention: Painted accessible bays suggest managed campus parking, not overnight stays.

flags: Painted accessible bays suggest restricted parking
sun_shade: Heavy tree shade from the east and south; buildings shade the west side in the morning.
